def _project_simplex(v, d):
    n = len(v)
    if n == 0 or d <= 0: return np.zeros(n)
    u = np.sort(v)[::-1]
    cssv = np.cumsum(u)
    idx = np.arange(1, n+1)
    cond = u - (cssv - d)/idx > 0
    rho = np.nonzero(cond)[0][-1]
    theta = (cssv[rho] - d)/(rho+1)
    return np.maximum(v - theta, 0.0)

def _project_capped(v, d):
    if v.sum() <= d and np.all(v >= 0): return np.clip(v, 0, None)
    return _project_simplex(np.clip(v,0,None), d)
